turns.prompt_text: can I doordash to go pick something up that I've already ordered
turns.response_html:
No, you cannot use the DoorDash app to pick up an order you have already placed directly with a restaurant.

DoorDash only handles orders made through its own platform. If you want to use the "Pickup" feature to avoid delivery fees, you must place the order through the DoorDash app from the start.

If you have already ordered via the restaurant:

  • Go yourself: Visit the restaurant and pick it up normally.
  • Third-party pickup: You cannot assign a "Dasher" to pick up a private order.
  • Cancel and Re-order: You could try to cancel your direct order and re-place it via DoorDash for pickup, but you may lose money if the restaurant has already started preparing the food.

Would you like me to find the steps for placing a new pickup order on DoorDash?

turns.prompt_text: can you do so using GrubHub or another service
turns.response_html:
No, you cannot use Grubhub or Uber Eats to pick up an existing order for the same reasons as DoorDash. They only fulfill orders placed directly through their own apps.

However, you can use courier-specific services designed for this exact purpose:

  • TaskRabbit: You can hire a "Tasker" to go to the restaurant, give them your order name/number, and have them deliver it to you.
  • Uber Connect: In some regions, Uber’s package delivery service allows you to send a driver to a location to pick up an item (like a prepaid food order) and bring it to you.
  • Getcho: A specialized app specifically for sending a courier to pick up orders you’ve already placed and paid for at local businesses.
  • Favor (Texas only): Drivers can be hired for custom errands, including picking up existing orders.

Important: If you use one of these, you must call the restaurant first to authorize the third party to pick up your food.

Would you like me to help you find the specific pricing for one of these courier services in your area?

In the Ankeny/Des Moines area, you can use the following services to pick up a pre-paid order:

  • Uber Connect: Usually the most affordable option, often costing around $10–$15 for local trips (pricing is distance-based and visible upfront in the Uber app under "Connect").
  • TaskRabbit: You can hire a "Tasker" for errand running starting at approximately $30–$35 per hour, which is ideal if the pickup requires extra steps or wait time.
  • Getcho: This app specifically handles "outside" pickups; you enter the store address and your order details to get a real-time quote before booking.

Remember to call the restaurant first to let them know a third-party courier will be picking up your order.
